```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidymodels)
library(tidyverse)
library(glmnet)
library(openxlsx)
```

```{r load-data}
setwd("..")
source("Visualization_and_preprocessing/S_protein_screen_preprocessing.R")
source("Embedded_FS/lasso_tidymodels.R")
split_dab_df_list = main_preprocessor()
```

```{r run-pipeline}
# n_param_opt_split = 0: delegates lambda selection to cv.glmnet's internal CV.
# Preferred here because feature_val_train is ~54 rows — too small for an
# explicit outer vfold on top of glmnet's own folds.
all_results = run_lasso_fs_all_dabs(
  split_dab_df_list,
  target            = "target_vector",
  threshold         = 0,
  prop_final_test   = 0.20,
  prop_feature_test = 0.20,
  n_param_opt_split = 0,
  n_top_features    = c(3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10),
  seed              = 2024
)
```

```{r compile-results}
all_run_summaries       = map_dfr(all_results, \(x) x$run_summary)
all_test_metrics        = map_dfr(all_results, \(x) x$test_metrics)
all_feature_rankings    = map_dfr(all_results, \(x) x$feature_ranking)
all_feature_val_results = map_dfr(all_results, \(x) x$feature_val_results)

all_run_summaries
```

```{r feature-count-selection, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
# Accuracy on feature_val_test across candidate feature counts, per dAb.
# The selected best_n for each dAb is marked with a point.
best_n_df = all_run_summaries |> select(dab, best_n_features)

all_feature_val_results |>
  filter(.metric == "accuracy") |>
  left_join(best_n_df, by = "dab") |>
  mutate(selected = n_features == best_n_features) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = n_features, y = .estimate)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue") +
  geom_point(aes(shape = selected, size = selected), color = "steelblue") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("FALSE" = 1, "TRUE" = 16)) +
  scale_size_manual(values  = c("FALSE" = 2, "TRUE" = 4)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::percent) +
  facet_wrap(~dab, ncol = 4) +
  labs(
    title = "Feature count selection — validation accuracy per dAb",
    x     = "Number of features",
    y     = "Accuracy (feature_val_test)",
    shape = "Selected N",
    size  = "Selected N"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r feature-importance, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
# Top 10 pairs by mean absolute LASSO coefficient, per dAb.
# Importance = mean |coef| across variant classes at best_penalty.
# Prefixing dab name to feature creates globally unique factor levels while
# still allowing per-facet ordering via arrange + factor(..., levels = .).
all_feature_rankings |>
  group_by(dab) |>
  slice_max(importance, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  arrange(dab, importance) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    feat_key = paste0(dab, "___", feature),
    feat_key = factor(feat_key, levels = feat_key)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = feat_key, y = importance)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = \(x) sub(".*___", "", x)) +
  facet_wrap(~dab, scales = "free", ncol = 4) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 antibody pairs by LASSO importance, per dAb",
    x     = NULL,
    y     = "Mean |coefficient|"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r selected-features}
# The specific pairs chosen for the final model of each dAb.
all_run_summaries |>
  select(dab, best_n_features, best_features) |>
  unnest_longer(best_features) |>
  group_by(dab, best_n_features) |>
  summarise(features = paste(best_features, collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r test-performance}
# Final accuracy and kappa on the held-out FINAL_TEST set, per dAb.
all_test_metrics |>
  select(dab, .metric, .estimate, seed) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = .metric, values_from = .estimate) |>
  arrange(desc(accuracy))
```

```{r test-performance-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
all_test_metrics |>
  filter(.metric == "accuracy") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(dab, .estimate), y = .estimate)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.25, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::percent) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Final test accuracy per dAb (LASSO-FS, seed 2024)",
    x     = NULL,
    y     = "Accuracy (final holdout)"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r confusion-matrices}
# Print confusion matrix for each dAb.
iwalk(all_results, function(result, dab_name) {
  cat("\n===", dab_name, "===\n")
  print(result$test_conf_mat)
})
```

```{r multi-seed, warning=FALSE}
# Run across three seeds to assess stability of feature selection and performance.
# This takes ~3× as long as a single run.
seeds = c(2024, 2025, 2026)

seed_runs = map(seeds, \(s) {
  message("Seed: ", s)
  run_lasso_fs_all_dabs(split_dab_df_list,
                        target            = "target_vector",
                        threshold         = 0,
                        n_param_opt_split = 0,
                        n_top_features    = c(3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10),
                        seed              = s)
})

multi_seed_summaries = map(seed_runs, \(r) map_dfr(r, \(x) x$run_summary)) |> bind_rows()
multi_seed_metrics   = map(seed_runs, \(r) map_dfr(r, \(x) x$test_metrics)) |> bind_rows()
```

```{r seed-stability, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
# Accuracy distribution across seeds per dAb — reveals which dAbs are stable.
multi_seed_metrics |>
  filter(.metric == "accuracy") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(dab, .estimate, median), y = .estimate)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = factor(seed)), width = 0.15, size = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = "Seed") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Test accuracy across seeds per dAb",
    x     = NULL,
    y     = "Accuracy (final holdout)"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r feature-frequency, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
# How often each pair appears in the selected feature set across seeds, per dAb.
multi_seed_summaries |>
  unnest_longer(best_features) |>
  count(dab, best_features, name = "seed_count") |>
  group_by(dab) |>
  slice_max(seed_count, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  arrange(dab, seed_count) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    feat_key = paste0(dab, "___", best_features),
    feat_key = factor(feat_key, levels = feat_key)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = feat_key, y = seed_count)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = \(x) sub(".*___", "", x)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq_len(length(seeds))) +
  facet_wrap(~dab, scales = "free", ncol = 4) +
  labs(
    title = "Feature selection frequency across seeds (top 10 per dAb)",
    x     = NULL,
    y     = "# seeds selected"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r save-results}
# Write per-dAb performance and selected features to the lasso_FS_results folder.
dir.create("Embedded_FS/lasso_FS_results", showWarnings = FALSE)

performance_wide = multi_seed_metrics |>
  filter(.metric %in% c("accuracy", "kap")) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = .metric, values_from = .estimate) |>
  arrange(dab, seed)

feature_summary = multi_seed_summaries |>
  unnest_longer(best_features) |>
  select(dab, seed, best_n_features, best_features)

write.xlsx(
  list(performance = performance_wide, features = feature_summary),
  file = "Embedded_FS/lasso_FS_results/lasso_tidymodels_results.xlsx"
)
```
